description: Suzanne Wikle is running as a Democrat to represent mostly southeastern parts of Lawrence in Kansas House District 10. Wikle — rhymes with Michael — shared her background in policy and advocacy, plus her views on child care, affordable health care and more.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Suzanne Wikle for Kansas
title: Meet a candidate for Kansas House District 10 — Suzanne Wikle | Democrat for Lawrence
